label: Nettlefield Health Partnership — Steady Steps
covers: One undifferentiated OUTCOMES column instead of short/medium/long. The items belong in generalOutcomes, and the failure to watch for is the model inventing a time horizon and splitting them across three columns.

slides.title: Nettlefield Health Partnership — Steady Steps Logic Model

columns.heading: INPUTS
items: Three community health workers employed through the partnership
A referral agreement with the Nettlefield GP practice

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: Twelve-week supervised walking groups meeting twice weekly
One-to-one health coaching calls every fortnight

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Two hundred and forty adults enrolled in a walking group
Nine hundred coaching calls completed across the year

columns.heading: OUTCOMES
items: Participants walk further in six minutes than they did at intake
Participants report sleeping better and feeling less isolated
Fewer participants are referred onward for cardiac assessment
Nettlefield GP practice records lower repeat attendance among participants
